stem: Before using a portable drill near benches and irrigation tubing, what should the operator establish first?
choices: A controlled operating zone, safe tool condition, correct accessory, and planned energy/shutdown method
A faster work pace so the tool spends less time near irrigation equipment
A coworker who can warn the operator if the tool approaches a hazard
A spare battery so the task is not interrupted by charging
rationale: Pre-use planning should control equipment condition, work zone, accessory fit, energy connection, and shutdown before the tool is energized.
